amendments.scope: All present and future public companion dossiers
amendments.reason: Identity lists must provide relevant specificity without implying that unnamed people fall outside claims about dignity, safety, belonging, or divine regard.
amendments.policy: State the universal claim first, mark examples as non-exhaustive, name materially implicated communities, and close universally. Do not use etc. for people.
amendments.approval_record: Approved by the project owner in the consolidated editorial conversation; LGBTQIA+ inclusion was named as an immediate concern.

amendments.reason: A short list of example identities can appear exhaustive even when introduced with non-restrictive language.
amendments.policy: State universal human dignity without requiring a list when a list adds no necessary interpretive precision.
amendments.approval_record: Requested by the project owner during live Reader 3.1.1 review as an application of the approved inclusive-list standard.
